adjustment.title: Learning path adjustment
adjustment.note: Based on this attempt and fixed learning rules, with no extra AI call. Review task and time changes before applying. Completed tasks and scores are preserved.
adjustment.timeChanges: Time changes to unfinished future tasks
adjustment.extra: I agree that the adjusted total exceeds the original budget by:
adjustment.applied: Applied. These tasks will not be added again.
adjustment.stale: Plan state or quiz results have changed. Recalculate before confirming.
adjustment.continue: Finish the remaining stage tasks first, then recalculate a challenge suggestion.
adjustment.historyOnly: Only the current plan's latest stage attempt can generate or apply new suggestions.

quiz.stageReady: Study tasks are complete. Continue with this stage assessment.
quiz.stageSequence: Complete the study tasks above, then take this stage assessment here.
quiz.noMistakes: No incorrect answers in this attempt.
quiz.title: Stage assessments
quiz.note: Each stage has five AI-generated single-choice questions; 4/5 passes. Retakes reuse the same quiz. Scores are learning feedback, not official course grades; check original materials if needed.
quiz.migration: Assessments are not enabled yet. Apply the assessment database migration first.
quiz.basis_materials: Questions use a subset of linked material text
quiz.basis_task_instructions: Questions use stage objectives and task instructions, not PDF text
quiz.resultNote: Submitting a quiz does not complete study tasks. Retakes are recorded; a high score on familiar questions is not a first-attempt mastery assessment.

taskStudy.not_linked: No material is linked to this task. Follow its study instructions.
taskStudy.migration_pending: Material page targeting is not enabled yet. Study instructions remain available.

pathResources.title: Related course materials
pathResources.note: These are accessible materials from this goal version's course, not AI-selected knowledge points. Reading does not change plan progress.
pathResources.no_course: No course is linked to this version. Revise the goal below and link a course to view its materials.
pathResources.unavailable: The related course is unavailable; materials cannot be read through this plan.
pathResources.locked: Your enrollment is not approved. Course materials are currently locked.
pathResources.empty: This course has no materials yet.

reading.title: Material reader
reading.note: Reading does not automatically complete a task. Extracted text may lose layout, formulas or images; refer to the original PDF.
reading.pdfHint: If embedding fails or the link expires, reload it or open it in a new tab.
reading.emptyPage: No text was extracted on this page. Please view the original PDF.
reading.no_text: No text was extracted. This may be a scanned or image-only PDF. OCR is not supported yet; view the original PDF.
reading.partial: Some text exceeded extraction limits. This is incomplete; refer to the original PDF.
reading.truncated: Text on this page has been truncated.

learningPath.completion_awaiting_assessment: Study tasks finished; stage quizzes still need passing
learningPath.completion_assessment_unavailable: Stage quizzes are unavailable; plan completion cannot be confirmed
learningPath.completionRule: Task progress counts study tasks only. Complete every task and score at least 4/5 on the latest attempt in every stage to complete the plan.
learningPath.continueQuiz: Continue to a pending stage quiz
learningPath.basis_materials: This plan includes tasks linked to supplied PDF pages. It uses a subset of accessible materials, not the entire course.
learningPath.basis_goal_and_description: Tasks have no PDF page references and are based on goals and available course descriptions, not unseen course PDFs.
learningPath.basis_unknown: Material-source information is unavailable for this plan.
learningPath.wait: Generating and validating tasks. Keep this page open and avoid submitting again.
learningPath.aiNotice: Generation sends your goal, course description and some accessible material text to the configured AI service. Validated results are saved; consult original materials while studying.
learningPath.title: My learning paths
learningPath.unavailable: AI is not configured. You can save goal drafts; configure the backend AI service to generate tasks.
learningPath.empty: No plans yet. Start by saving a learning goal.
learningPath.revise: Revise goal and save a new version
learningPath.readOnly: This is not the active version; task progress is read-only. The active plan is unchanged.

courses.title: Course catalog
